payload.text: ST0011/02 (WP02b) after WP02a: the items in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/st11-wp01b/handover/STATE.md (For WP02b): the candidate ref to the project's GitHub remote found against release.repo, the tag on green to every remote in release.remotes, one push per distinct URL, a remote leg's pair under tmp/release/legs/<name>/ and never copied into the local record directory, the absent leg word, WSL blocks nothing; and dc's two WP03 lines in WP02's objective: lib/config refuses release.ci.workflow and release.ci.summary only beside a bespoke ci.query, and a release block holding only ci keys passes validation. From vc (2026-10-31): AC-6.3 under D69, pre-flight refuses a gate in all that is active on none of the cut's legs, local and remote, naming the gate and its platforms (WP17's platforms: predicate, dc's, after run 3, against each leg's probed platform); WP03's checker half (AC-3.1): dc's pure ci-state reader says whether the test workflow fires on candidate/ refs, cc wires its two call lines in release check and the cut's pre-flight, agreeing its name and words with dc before either banks, and pre-flight refuses a release.ci.workflow the tree does not hold; ci.wait's default becomes 60m (lib/config:549 says 20m) with its doc line and an arm reading the default, and nothing printed beyond release check's declared-or-default listing. Agreed with dc (2026-10-31, cc's answer in dc's inbox): the call lines run bin/devbin ci-state --fires <ref> <sha>, one line <word><TAB><reason>, exit 0 whenever it answered, words fires, quiet, missing (no workflow at <sha>, which covers the pre-flight's refusal of a release.ci.workflow the tree does not hold) and unknown; the pre-flight passes HEAD and release.publish.candidate with {tag} filled in, from the one function that names the ref the cut pushes, release check the ref for the next cut's tag, each refusing on anything but fires with the reason; in the publish shape the pre-flight also checks that the snapshot carries .github/workflows/<wf> unchanged; ci-state's failed line names the failed jobs, printed verbatim. paths-ignore (dc, agreed 2026-10-31 15:0xZ): read as the walk reads it, a <dir>/** entry leaving the answer to the branch filter and any other shape, or an inline list, unknown naming the entry; a release commit whose every change falls under an ignored tree starts no run, so the candidate leg ends red at ci.wait with nothing public. With dc (2026-10-31 15:39Z by date -u, after WP03's review): ci-state's failed line reads failed<TAB>run <id> (<conclusion>; failed jobs: a, b), printed verbatim; the call lines ask --fires only when release.ci.query is the built-in, through the one predicate of that (dc's, beside lib/config's refusal of ci.workflow and ci.summary next to a bespoke query), else release check says the trigger is the bespoke query's to read and the pre-flight goes on, the candidate leg failing safe at ci.wait; --fires keeps unknown for a bespoke query as a backstop; WP02b adds is_branch_name <name> to lib/helpers beside is_commit_sha (git check-ref-format refs/heads/<name>) and moves lib/cmd/release's two check-ref-format sites onto it, ci-state following in dc's unit.
